claims.evidence: Photos show a Sony PS4 console but give no indication of import region or usage history; no UK-specific marking visible.
Photo 0 shows a camouflage-patterned controller, Photo 1 shows a different plain black controller — two distinct pads appear across the two images, not one.

claims.claim: 10 pre-installed games including FIFA 27, PES 27, GTA
claims.evidence: No screen, menu, or storage listing is shown to confirm any installed games. Additionally, 'FIFA 27' and 'PES 27' are not existing released titles, making this part of the claim factually impossible as stated.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or function correctly
risks.proof: Video clip of console booting to the home screen
Photo of the rear/bottom label showing HDD size or system settings storage screen
Photo of all included cables laid out next to console
risks.if_unproven: priced as console-only, cables not included

risks.risk: Mismatched or only one controller actually included
risks.proof: Single photo showing both controllers together with console to confirm quantity and which ones are included
risks.if_unproven: priced as single generic controller, ignore the second

risks.risk: Games may not actually be pre-installed or titles may be mislabeled/fake
risks.proof: Screenshot of the PS4 library/menu showing installed game list
risks.if_unproven: priced as console with no verified games

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage, port wear, or internal issues not visible in given angles
risks.proof: Close-up photos of ports, disc slot, and all sides of the unit
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming moderate wear, worst-case cosmetic condition

proof_requests: Video of console powering on and reaching the home screen
Photo of rear label or system settings showing storage capacity
Photo of all cables and controllers laid out together
Screenshot of actual installed game library
Close-up photos of all ports and console edges for damage
response.reason: The seller claims pre-installed 'FIFA 27' and 'PES 27', titles that do not exist, which is a strong signal of a fabricated or deceptive listing; combined with a controller-count contradiction in the photos, this warrants fraud suspicion rather than a straightforward worst-case pricing.
